integrity: A theorem-level derivation from explicitly cited published results, with independent finite-cell consistency checks; not independently audited or externally certified.
scientific_limitations: The result uses published nonequivariant Hom-complex connectivity; only odd-prime target-color rotations are treated. title: Prime cyclic color quotients of triangle-coloring Hom complexes: integral homology and cup-length
